definitions.explanation: The smallest unit of a digital image or display, representing a single point of color.

examples.japanese: {画素|がそ}⟦{数|すう}→数：03360_suu⟧⟦が→が：00051_ga⟧⟦{多|おお}い→多い：01127_ooi⟧⟦ほど→ほど：01724_hodo⟧⟦{画質|がしつ}→画質：16156_gashitsu⟧⟦が→が：00051_ga⟧⟦いい→いい：00118_ii⟧。
examples.english: The more pixels, the better the image quality.

examples.japanese: {画素|がそ}⟦が→が：00051_ga⟧⟦{粗|あら}い→粗い：00439_arai⟧⟦と→と：00512_to⟧⟦{写真|しゃしん}→写真：00753_shashin⟧⟦が→が：00051_ga⟧⟦ぼやける→ぼやける：16967_boyakeru⟧。
examples.english: If the pixels are coarse, the photo looks blurry.

notes:
{画素|がそ} is the Japanese term for 'pixel'—the smallest unit of a digital image.

ETYMOLOGY:
{画|が} (image) + {素|そ} (element) = picture element (pixel)

COMMON COLLOCATIONS:
- {画素|がそ}⟦{数|すう}→数：03360_suu⟧: pixel count
- ⟦{高|こう}→高い：00500_takai⟧{画素|がそ}: high resolution
- {画素|がそ}⟦{密度|みつど}→密度：15137_mitsudo⟧: pixel density (PPI)
- 〜⟦{万|まん}→万：00795_man⟧{画素|がそ}: ~ megapixels

CAMERA SPECIFICATIONS:
- 1200⟦{万|まん}→万：00795_man⟧{画素|がそ}: 12 megapixels
- ⟦{有効|ゆうこう}→有効：03645_yuukou⟧{画素|がそ}⟦{数|すう}→数：03360_suu⟧: effective pixel count

ALTERNATIVE:
⟦ピクセル→ピクセル：noentry⟧ (pixel) is also commonly used, especially in technical contexts. Both terms are interchangeable.

RELATED WORDS:
- ⟦{解像度|かいぞうど}→解像度：04888_kaizoudo⟧: resolution
- ⟦{画質|がしつ}→画質：16156_gashitsu⟧: image quality
